map.不一样。IOM 对双胎建议更高：正常 BMI 增 16.8-24.5kg、超重: They differ. IOM recommends more for twins: normal BMI gain 16.8-24.5 kg, overweight 14.1-22.7 kg, obese 11.3-19.1 kg. This tool uses singleton standards, so follow medical advice for multiples.
map.增速过快（如远超周增重上限）需警惕妊娠期高血压/糖尿病风险；过慢可能提示营养或胎: Gaining too fast (far above the weekly limit) raises the risk of gestational hypertension or diabetes; too slow may point to nutrition or fetal growth problems. The numbers are for reference only; follow fundal height and ultrasound at your checkups.
